description: Операционная аналитика ритейла: данные из Postgres через CDC. ADR-0011.

panels.description: Сумма revenue_net витрины mart_revenue_daily за выбранный период.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(revenue_net) AS revenue_net FROM shopflow.mart_revenue_daily WHERE $__dateFilter(order_date)

panels.title: Выручка без отменённых

panels.description: Из воронки: orders в витрине выручки считает заказ в каждой его категории.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(created) AS created FROM shopflow.mart_funnel_daily WHERE $__dateFilter(order_date)

panels.title: Заказов создано

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * sum(paid) / nullIf(sum(created), 0), 1) AS paid_pct FROM shopflow.mart_funnel_daily WHERE $__dateFilter(order_date)
SELECT round(100 * sum(delivered) / nullIf(sum(created), 0), 1) AS delivered_pct FROM shopflow.mart_funnel_daily WHERE $__dateFilter(order_date)

panels.description: День — UTC-дата создания заказа, категория на момент заказа (SCD2).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(order_date) AS time, category, sum(revenue_net) AS revenue_net FROM shopflow.mart_revenue_daily WHERE $__dateFilter(order_date) GROUP BY time, category ORDER BY time

panels.title: Выручка по дням и категориям (без отменённых)

targets.rawSql: SELECT category, sum(revenue_net) AS revenue_net, sum(revenue) AS revenue, sum(items) AS items FROM shopflow.mart_revenue_daily WHERE $__dateFilter(order_date) GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue_net DESC

panels.description: Дошли до статуса (монотонно: доставленный считается и оплаченным). Оплаченный заказ может потом попасть в отменённые.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(order_date) AS time, created, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled FROM shopflow.mart_funnel_daily WHERE $__dateFilter(order_date) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Заказы по статусам по дням

panels.description: Только реальные переходы (не снимки); день без переходов — пропуск, не 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(order_date) AS time, to_paid_median_s, to_paid_p90_s, paid_to_delivered_median_s, paid_to_delivered_p90_s FROM shopflow.mart_funnel_daily WHERE $__dateFilter(order_date) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Время переходов: медиана и p90

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(created) AS `создан`, sum(paid) AS `оплачен`, sum(shipped) AS `отгружен`, sum(delivered) AS `доставлен`, sum(cancelled) AS `отменён` FROM shopflow.mart_funnel_daily WHERE $__dateFilter(order_date)

panels.description: Когорта — месяц первого неотменённого заказа клиента; M+N — доля клиентов когорты с неотменённым заказом через N месяцев. Незаконченный текущий месяц не показан (пусто), повторный заказ в месяц первого заказа возвратом не считается. Первые 12 месяцев.

targets.rawSql: SELECT formatDateTime(cohort_month, '%Y-%m') AS `когорта`, max(customers) AS `клиентов`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 0 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 0 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+0`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 1 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 1 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+1`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 2 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 2 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+2`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 3 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 3 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+3`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 4 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 4 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+4`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 5 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 5 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+5`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 6 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 6 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+6`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 7 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 7 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+7`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 8 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 8 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+8`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 9 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 9 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+9`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 10 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 10 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+10`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 11 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 11 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+11`, round(100 * sumIf(returned, period = 12 AND is_partial = 0) / nullIf(sumIf(customers, period = 12 AND is_partial = 0), 0), 1) AS `M+12` FROM shopflow.mart_cohort_retention GROUP BY cohort_month ORDER BY cohort_month DESC

panels.title: Удержание по когортам, % от размера когорты

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(cohort_month) AS time, max(customers) AS customers FROM shopflow.mart_cohort_retention GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Окно 7 суток по UTC-дню создания заказа, включая сегодня; сумма по дням витрины mart_top_products_daily.

targets.rawSql: SELECT product_id, argMax(product_name, order_date) AS `товар`, sum(quantity_net) AS `штук`, sum(revenue_net) AS `выручка` FROM shopflow.mart_top_products_daily WHERE order_date >= toDate(now('UTC')) - 6 GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY `выручка` DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Топ-10 товаров за 7 дней (без отменённых)

targets.rawSql: SELECT product_id, argMax(product_name, order_date) AS `товар`, sum(quantity_net) AS `штук`, sum(revenue_net) AS `выручка` FROM shopflow.mart_top_products_daily WHERE order_date >= toDate(now('UTC')) - 29 GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY `выручка` DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: Остаток меньше 20 штук (порог в DDL mart_inventory_current).

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(is_low = 1) AS low FROM shopflow.mart_inventory_current

panels.title: Позиций с низким остатком

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(quantity) AS units FROM shopflow.mart_inventory_current
SELECT category, sum(quantity) AS units FROM shopflow.mart_inventory_current GROUP BY category ORDER BY units DESC
SELECT product_name AS `товар`, category AS `категория`, warehouse_id AS `склад`, quantity AS `остаток` FROM shopflow.mart_inventory_current WHERE is_low = 1 ORDER BY quantity, product_id LIMIT 50

panels.description: Витрины пересчитываются раз в 2 минуты цепочкой. Оранжевый — цепочка отстаёт (> 4 мин), красный — стоит (> 10 мин).

targets.rawSql: SELECT dateDiff('second', max(refreshed_at), now('UTC')) AS refresh_age_s FROM shopflow.mart_pipeline_health

panels.title: Возраст последнего refresh витрин

panels.description: После ~4,5 млн строк fact_orders переходит на таблицу (ADR-0009).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toUInt64(argMax(ch_value, checked_at)) AS items FROM shopflow.dq_check_results FINAL WHERE check_name = 'table_size' AND table_name = 'stg_order_items'

panels.title: stg_order_items, строк (порог ~4,5 млн)

panels.description: Возраст refresh — здоровье цепочки. Отставание от источника (now − source_watermark) растёт, когда в Postgres тихо или ноутбук выключен: это не поломка пайплайна.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'mart_revenue_daily' AS `витрина`, dateDiff('second', max(refreshed_at), now('UTC')) AS `возраст refresh, с`, dateDiff('second', max(source_watermark), now('UTC')) AS `отставание от источника, с` FROM shopflow.mart_revenue_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_funnel_daily' AS `витрина`, dateDiff('second', max(refreshed_at), now('UTC')) AS `возраст refresh, с`, dateDiff('second', max(source_watermark), now('UTC')) AS `отставание от источника, с` FROM shopflow.mart_funnel_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_cohort_retention' AS `витрина`, dateDiff('second', max(refreshed_at), now('UTC')) AS `возраст refresh, с`, dateDiff('second', max(source_watermark), now('UTC')) AS `отставание от источника, с` FROM shopflow.mart_cohort_retention UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_top_products_daily' AS `витрина`, dateDiff('second', max(refreshed_at), now('UTC')) AS `возраст refresh, с`, dateDiff('second', max(source_watermark), now('UTC')) AS `отставание от источника, с` FROM shopflow.mart_top_products_daily UNION ALL SELECT 'mart_inventory_current' AS `витрина`, dateDiff('second', max(refreshed_at), now('UTC')) AS `возраст refresh, с`, dateDiff('second', max(source_watermark), now('UTC')) AS `отставание от источника, с` FROM shopflow.mart_inventory_current

panels.title: Свежесть витрин

panels.description: Пусто в давности (NULL) — в таблице ещё нет строк.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS `источник`, last_event_time AS `последнее событие`, dateDiff('second', last_event_time, now('UTC')) AS `давность, с` FROM shopflow.mart_pipeline_health WHERE kind = 'source' ORDER BY name

panels.title: Источники: последнее событие

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS `MV`, status AS `статус`, last_success_time AS `последний успех`, dateDiff('second', last_success_time, now('UTC')) AS `давность, с`, ifNull(last_error, '') AS `ошибка` FROM shopflow.mart_pipeline_health WHERE kind = 'view' ORDER BY name

panels.description: Сторож самого Airflow: красный при > 26 ч без планового запуска; 99999 — планового запуска ещё не было. Падение задачи из-за перезапуска scheduler алерт не шлёт (ADR-0011), здесь это видно.

targets.rawSql: WITH ages AS (SELECT toString(dag_id) AS dag_id, dateDiff('hour', max(checked_at), now('UTC')) AS age_h FROM shopflow.dq_check_results FINAL WHERE table_name = '' AND startsWith(run_id, 'scheduled__') GROUP BY dag_id), known AS (SELECT mapFromArrays(groupArray(dag_id), groupArray(age_h)) AS m FROM ages) SELECT d AS dag_id, if(mapContains(m, d), m[d], 99999) AS `часов` FROM known ARRAY JOIN ['shopflow_reconciliation', 'shopflow_data_quality', 'shopflow_retention'] AS d ORDER BY dag_id

panels.title: Возраст последнего планового запуска, ч

panels.description: Последний плановый запуск каждого DAG: сверка (FR-8), качество данных (FR-9), ретеншн (NFR-5). Худшие статусы сверху.

targets.rawSql: WITH last_runs AS (SELECT dag_id, argMax(run_id, checked_at) AS last_run_id FROM shopflow.dq_check_results FINAL WHERE table_name = '' AND startsWith(run_id, 'scheduled__') GROUP BY dag_id) SELECT r.dag_id AS dag_id, r.check_name AS `проверка`, r.table_name AS `таблица`, toString(r.status) AS status, r.violations AS `нарушений`, r.checked_at AS `когда` FROM shopflow.dq_check_results AS r FINAL WHERE (r.dag_id, r.run_id) IN (SELECT dag_id, last_run_id FROM last_runs) AND r.check_name != 'table_size' ORDER BY r.dag_id, r.status DESC, r.check_name, r.table_name

panels.title: Статус последних плановых запусков

panels.description: Отдельно от плановых: ручной запуск (например, с simulate_violation) не красит плановую секцию.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dag_id, run_id, toString(status) AS status, checked_at AS `когда` FROM shopflow.dq_check_results FINAL WHERE table_name = '' AND check_name != 'table_size' AND NOT startsWith(run_id, 'scheduled__') ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Ручные и тестовые запуски (последние 10)

panels.description: Тренд диска и порог ADR-0009; пишет shopflow_retention.

targets.rawSql: SELECT table_name AS `таблица`, toUInt64(ch_value) AS `строк`, JSONExtractUInt(details, 'bytes_on_disk') AS `на диске` FROM shopflow.dq_check_results FINAL WHERE check_name = 'table_size' AND run_id = (SELECT argMax(run_id, checked_at) FROM shopflow.dq_check_results FINAL WHERE check_name = 'table_size') ORDER BY `на диске` DESC

panels.title: Размеры таблиц (по данным ретеншн-DAG)

panels.description: Плановая проба shopflow_alert_channel раз в 3 часа: GET без токена на Bot API из контейнера scheduler. Красный — алерты в Telegram не доходят (туннель, ADR-0012), хотя DAG-и зелёные; 99999 — проверок ещё не было.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(countIf(status = 'ok') = 0, 99999, dateDiff('hour', maxIf(checked_at, status = 'ok'), now('UTC'))) AS age_h FROM shopflow.dq_check_results FINAL WHERE check_name = 'telegram_reachable' AND table_name = ''

panels.title: Канал алертов: часов с последней успешной проверки Telegram
